states.label: Protected
states.treatment: The two gates settle into place, then stay still.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview implements the two-gate 0.6-second settle on entry, preserving the protected transition timing.

states.label: Reconnecting
states.treatment: An offset wave moves through the two gates. The symbol keeps its shape.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview implements the two-gate 1.5-second opacity wave. “Loading” can share this motion only while connection or setup is actually pending.

states.label: Paused
states.treatment: Quiet gates and a small pause sign keep the state recognizable without motion.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview dims both Switch gates to 40% and adds two static pause bars.

states.label: Needs attention
states.treatment: One gate carries a slow amber pulse; a small marker remains when motion stops.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview implements the lower-gate amber pulse at the existing 1.8-second timing, plus a persistent attention marker.

states.label: Managed
states.summary: Settings are managed by your team.
states.treatment: A gate bar joins the two halves. Clear ownership, without an alert.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview joins the Switch gates with the static central managed bar.

states.label: Signed out
states.treatment: The solid mark becomes an outline. Present, but not active.
states.sourceMapping: The native preview draws the Switch gates as dimmed outlines.
